sources.quote: And Chisone is conditional, the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) has conditional qualification. Delivering BR-180 to a new plant (Pinerolo) is new business, which the supplier may not receive now.

No controlled record gives Chisone an approval for BR-180 at Pinerolo for the customer. The only BR-180 record for Chisone is DEV-114, which is expired and concerned a hardness deviation, not a source release. This is not proof of non-approval, so a person must confirm whether a release exists for PLT-PIN. The customer is taken as Aurelia from DEV-114.
